name: claude-channel-telegram
description: Telegram channel for Claude Code: tg-router (Rust, single Bot API poller) + tg-bridge (Rust, per-session stdio relay). Dev dependencies are only for router/*.test.ts.

scripts.build: cargo build --release --manifest-path router-rs/Cargo.toml && cargo build --release --manifest-path bridge/Cargo.toml
scripts.test: bun router/e2e.test.ts && bun router/restart.test.ts && bun router/extra.test.ts
